about.headerDesc: A communication bridge between citizens and the government structures of Addis Ababa — Woredas and Sub-Cities.
about.para1: EthioBridge is a centralized web-based platform that connects citizens with government structures — the Woredas and Sub-Cities of Addis Ababa. It gives citizens a reliable and efficient way to submit infrastructure problems and public complaints, receive official public alerts, and donate to infrastructural, community, and educational fundraising campaigns.
about.para2: Reports submitted by citizens are first routed to the responsible Woreda office. If a report is not resolved at the Woreda level, it is automatically escalated to the Sub-City level, and citizens receive feedback and status updates on their reports throughout the entire process.
about.featureInfraDesc: Report damaged roads, water, electricity, and public facilities so they get fixed faster — with or without logging in.
about.featureComplaintDesc: Submit complaints related to corruption, peace and security, public services, and other community concerns. Your complaint is forwarded to the responsible authority for review and action.
about.featureAlertDesc: Government offices at the Woreda and Sub-City levels issue emergency alerts to citizens — such as electricity outages, flooding, or security notices — in real time.
about.featureFundraisingDesc: Woreda and Sub-City entities create campaigns to support local infrastructure, education, and community projects, and any person can donate easily.
about.featureAnalyticsDesc: Track performance, trends, and resolutions through clear, transparent reports.
about.missionDesc: To provide a secure, accessible, and transparent digital platform that enables citizens to report infrastructure problems and public complaints, receive public alerts, and contribute to community fundraising — in close collaboration with Woreda and Sub-City government offices.
about.visionDesc: To become Addis Ababa's leading digital platform connecting citizens with their government — strengthening collaboration, improving public service delivery, and enhancing the safety and well-being of every community.
about.step1Desc: A citizen submits an infrastructure problem or public complaint with photos and location — with or without logging in.
about.step2Desc: The system records the report and immediately routes it to the responsible Woreda office.
about.step3Desc: The Woreda office reviews the report and begins working to resolve it.
about.step4Desc: If the issue is not resolved at the Woreda level, the report is automatically escalated to the Sub-City level.
about.step5Desc: The Sub-City assigns the report to the relevant department or team for resolution.
about.step6Desc: Status and feedback are updated as the responsible office works on the report.
about.step7Desc: The citizen receives status answers and feedback at each stage of the process.
about.step8Desc: The issue is fully resolved and the report is closed with the citizen notified.
about.valueTransparencyDesc: Ensuring clear communication and report tracking at every stage.
about.valueAccountabilityDesc: Promoting responsibility in responding to community issues.
about.valueCollaborationDesc: Encouraging cooperation among citizens, Woredas, and Sub-Cities.
about.valueIntegrityDesc: Maintaining accurate and trustworthy information across the platform.
about.valueInnovationDesc: Using technology to improve public service delivery for all Ethiopians.
about.valueEmpowermentDesc: Giving citizens a voice in identifying and solving local challenges.
about.usersDesc: EthioBridge connects citizens with Woreda and Sub-City government structures, supported by a system administrator.
about.roleCitizenDesc: Submits infrastructure problems and public complaints, donates to community campaigns, and tracks reports to resolution.
about.roleWoredaDesc: Receives citizen reports first and works to resolve them within its jurisdiction.
about.roleSubcityDesc: Oversees Woredas and handles reports that escalate beyond the Woreda level.
about.roleAdminDesc: Controls, monitors, and manages the entire system.
about.ctaDesc: Be part of a platform building a safer, better-connected Addis Ababa.

faq.headerDesc: Everything you need to know about using EthioBridge.
faq.q1: How do I submit a report?
faq.a1: Register an account, log in as a citizen, and use the "Create Report" button in your dashboard. Select the report type (Infrastructure, Emergency, or Missing Person), fill in the required details, upload photos, and select your location on the map.
faq.q2: How can I track my report?
faq.a2: After logging in, go to "My Reports" in your citizen dashboard. You can see the current status, progress history, and any updates from responsible organizations for each of your submitted reports.
faq.a3: System administrators review and verify all submitted reports. They check the accuracy and completeness of information before forwarding verified reports to the appropriate government organization or NGO.
faq.q4: How do NGOs receive emergency requests?
faq.a4: Once an emergency report is verified by the administrator, all approved NGO organizations are automatically notified. They can then review the request and accept it if they are able to provide the required assistance.
faq.a5: Yes. EthioBridge uses industry-standard JWT authentication, encrypted passwords, and role-based access control. Your personal information is only visible to authorized administrators and relevant organizations.
faq.q6: How do I register as a government organization or NGO?
faq.a6: Click "Register" and select your organization type (Government or NGO). Fill in your organization details and submit. Your registration will be reviewed and approved by the system administrator before you can access the platform.
faq.a7: Currently, you need an account to submit reports. However, missing person tips can be marked as anonymous. Your contact details are protected and not shown publicly.
faq.q8: How long does it take to verify a report?
faq.a8: Administrators aim to verify reports as quickly as possible. Emergency reports are prioritized and typically verified within hours. Other reports are verified within 24–48 hours.
faq.q9: What happens after my report is resolved?
faq.a9: Once an organization marks your report as resolved, you will receive a notification. You can view the full resolution details in your "My Reports" section.
faq.q10: How do I register as a volunteer?
faq.a10: Click "Register" and select "Volunteer" as your role. Fill in your skills and location. Volunteer accounts are automatically approved so you can start accepting tasks right away.
faq.q11: Can I update a report after submitting?
faq.a11: You can view your report and its progress, but editing submitted reports is managed by the assigned organization or administrator to maintain data integrity.
faq.q12: What if my report is rejected?
faq.a12: If your report is rejected, you will receive a notification explaining the reason. You can then submit a new, corrected report if appropriate.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Content: We collect information you provide directly to us when you register for an account, submit reports, or contact our support team. This includes your name, email address, phone number, location data, and uploaded photographs relevant to reports.
privacy.s2Content: We use the information we collect to provide and improve our services, verify your identity, process and forward reports to appropriate organizations, send notifications about report status updates, and ensure the security of our platform.
privacy.s3Content: We share your information only with authorized government organizations, NGOs, and volunteers as necessary to respond to the reports you submit. We do not sell your personal information to third parties. Public-facing report pages protect your personal identity.
privacy.s4Content: We implement industry-standard security measures including encrypted passwords (bcrypt), JWT authentication, HTTPS data transmission, and role-based access controls to protect your personal information against unauthorized access.
privacy.s5Content: We retain your account information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services. Report data may be retained for longer periods for statistical and planning purposes in anonymized form.
privacy.s6Content: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time through your account settings. You may also request that we restrict processing of your data or provide a copy of your data in a portable format.
privacy.s7Content: We use essential cookies to maintain your session and preferences. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies. You can control cookie settings through your browser.
privacy.s8Content: EthioBridge is not directed to children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe we have collected such information, please contact us immediately.
privacy.s9Content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by posting a notice on our platform. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.s10Content: If you have questions about this privacy policy or your personal data, contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@ethiobridge.et or at our office in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.s1Content: By accessing or using EthioBridge, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our platform.
terms.s2Content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You must provide accurate and complete information when registering and keep your information up to date.
terms.s3Content: You agree to use EthioBridge only for lawful purposes. You must not submit false, misleading, or fraudulent reports. You must not use the platform to harass, threaten, or harm others. You must not attempt to gain unauthorized access to any part of the system.
terms.s4Content: When submitting reports, you agree that the information provided is accurate to the best of your knowledge. False reports may result in account suspension. The platform reserves the right to remove any report that violates these terms or is deemed inappropriate.
terms.s5Content: All content, design, and functionality of EthioBridge is the property of EthioBridge and is protected by applicable intellectual property laws. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without explicit written permission.
terms.s6Content: EthioBridge provides the platform as a communication bridge and is not responsible for the actions or inactions of government organizations, NGOs, or volunteers in responding to reports. We are not liable for any damages arising from use of the platform.
terms.s7Content: Government organizations and NGOs registered on the platform are responsible for their own actions in responding to reports. They must comply with all applicable laws and regulations. EthioBridge does not guarantee response times or outcomes.
terms.s8Content: Your use of the platform is also governed by our Privacy Policy, which is incorporated into these Terms by reference. By using EthioBridge, you consent to the collection and use of your information as described in the Privacy Policy.
terms.s9Content: EthioBridge reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, submit false reports, or engage in behavior that disrupts the platform or harms other users.
terms.s10Content: These Terms are governed by the laws of Ethiopia. Any disputes arising from the use of this platform shall be resolved in the courts of Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
terms.s11Content: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. We will provide notice of significant changes through the platform. Your continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.
terms.s12Content: For questions about these Terms, contact us at legal@ethiobridge.et or at our office in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
